pivot: grip centre at the origin; +X to the tip; flats of the blade on +Z / -Z (see tools/build_weapons.py)

known_weaknesses: The shine is an emissive map on the blade (0.9 nits in game by the kit material: at 6 and at 45 the blade was a flat white shape in daylight, with no steel left to see): it lights nothing around it and has no halo; a light or bloom is runtime work. Baked from a procedural source: no maker's marks, engraving or damage from use beyond stains and edge wear. Static (no cloth, tassel or scabbard). The grip transform was derived from the hand bone landmarks and checked in one idle and one attack frame only.

grip.x: towards the tip (upper limb for a bow)
